items.text: Hey friends!
We’ve released today’s patch that includes some fixes and balancing updates.

notes.title: Let’s tell you what we’ve included in this

items.text: Fixed an issue where players' profile pictures in places like parties or friend lists should now correctly show rank instead of paper frame
Fixed an issue with swapping skins during matches. This now works as intended in most scenarios
Fixed avatar selection arrows, they now pass on the next page correctly
Fixed Titan's heal potency debuff. This now correctly gets removed when the Titan's reverse card is used
Fixed an issue where Katana no longer wastes (blocks without any positive effect) ammos on road, lava, explosive, or bear trap damages
Fixed spawning in Data Center no longer rotating your character in certain scenarios
Trees in the Woods map can't be climbed anymore
SDD should have a more accurate result in a tie even if some players have high ping
Previous/Next texts on the spectator screen now disappear if the action isn't possible
Spectators will now correctly see the full content of the hand of each player
Getting out of bounds on Reality should now be much more difficult
Cloud can now be player's favorite character on the statistic profile menu
When having Ribberto as the player's favorite character, it now shows Ribberto instead of Myk (yes)
Small but mighty quest can now be completed like any other quest
'Crosswire' cardback now is shown as intended

Fixed Karrotov bug. Fixed inconsistencies with Karrotov’s fire: some players weren’t burning, while they appeared to be burning from the enemy’s perspective. Also fixed an issue where the burning effect could persist into the next round, dealing 0 damage.
Now level up pop up is showing properly
Reroll Quest feature
PS5: fixed data center map
PS5: fixed Full time job trophy
Xbox: fixed Full time job achievement

Fire rate : -33%

Max Cost : 1 -> 2
Cost : 2 -> 3
Cost : 2 -> 1
Thanks for your continued support of Friends vs Friends! <3

We have some bad news. Cloud, the new character who came from the future to save the game, has turned out to be a complete idiot and wants to introduce new predatory mechanics into the game. Anyway, here’s the trailer:

Cloud’s Despicable Roulette™: We have forcibly introduced a roulette mechanic that will speed up the acquisition of Red Coins, which now have a much higher maximum limit (increased from 200 to 999,999). Obviously, it’s great, even though nobody likes it.

A bunch of cosmetics: We’ve added around 50 cosmetic items, including weapons, characters, card backs, and avatars. To make some of this content easier to access and avoid having to rely entirely on random items, we’ve introduced some really expensive options that allow you to get them without going through the Pal Prize.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/88b85214e355a8d66e1ec1d9139c2adf9f748046.png"]

Changing skins between matches: In order to let you flex the skins you own during matches and justify your gambling addiction, you can now change your character skins between rounds. It’s a minor addition, but it’ll make you feel better after losing everything at the roulette table.

Copy/Paste Decks: You can now copy your deck into a line of text that you can send to your friends, so they don’t have to manually set up your recommendations. They can simply use a button to paste the line of text you sent them.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/5cac559fd6abd97e639acccd753c3619b2a05761.png"]

High polling rate mice causing heavy stuttering while moving quickly:
Let me stop for a moment here. Since the last update, we found that some players were experiencing pretty severe stuttering when using high polling rate mice.

We’ve invested a lot of time looking into this, and it appears to be related either to Rewired, a widely used input plugin we rely on, or to the way Unity handles mouse input natively. Other developers seem to be struggling with similar issues too, so unfortunately there isn’t an obvious solution yet, especially since the problem can be somewhat inconsistent.
However, we’ve found a middle ground between the previous behavior and the optimal solution, which should significantly improve the situation for affected players. We’ll keep working on it!

As a final note, we would like to remind everyone that roulettes and other random elements that the game may contain, despite being dopamine dispensers, use both visual and cognitive cues that can potentially lead to unhealthy behaviours in real life, even if they are fun.
More updates await us in the future!! (farewell)
Brainwash Gang & Raw Fury
Cloud AKA The Friend of the Real Hardcore Gamers

PS: There have been some criticisms regarding the fact that we announced another game we’ve been working on. We understand that it may be perceived as abandoning Friends vs. Friends, but the reality is more complicated. We don’t get an incredible return from the game that would make this a sustainable investment of time and money. We do what we can with the resources we have, and the most stable way for us to keep going is by funding new projects.

notes.title: Here are some of the things we found

items.text: Back to the Past: The Floor Is Lava card now works as intended and also goes back in time.
Trash Thief: It now picks a random card from your opponent’s graveyard.
Easy Anti-Cheat: The game now forces the installation if you don’t have it installed.: and…

Mouse with high polling rates causing FPS drops: Okay, so let’s talk about this one because it’s important.: We found that this issue is related to Unity, the engine we use for the game. We’ve seen other developers reporting the same issue, but so far, no one has been able to find a proper solution.: We’ve tried everything possible, but it seems to be a mix of hardware and OS-related issues. So, at the moment, we’re still trying to figure it out, just like many other developers.: This means we’re going to keep looking into it as much as we can, but it’s quite tricky because we can’t reproduce the issue on our own systems.: Some people have experienced it and then suddenly seen it disappear, which only adds even more complexity to the problem.: The only thing we’ve found that seems to help is going into your mouse software and lowering the polling rate. Setting it below 1000 Hz shouldn’t cause stuttering.: We know this isn’t the best solution, but if you’re experiencing the issue, you can give it a try while we continue looking for a proper fix.: Sorry for the inconvenience!: And yeah, this is the classic stuff that every game developer says, but we’re actually quite excited about the next update. We haven’t done anything quite like it before, so let’s see how it turns out!: Thanks for your time <3

notes.title: Issues with matchmaking in Australian regions

items.text: Additionally, we've received numerous reports about high ping issues & incorrect 'best regions' from users based in Australia. We've been going through this issue with our multiplayer server provider and found out that this issue is, for now, exclusive to all players who have internet provided by the company Optus, or any ISP that relays on the Optus network.
If that's your case, we're terribly sorry, but there's not much we can do on our side. We can tell you about some workarounds some of you found, though!
1. Using Cloudflare WARP. You can access it here: https://1.1.1.1 (it looks shady but we promise it's not!). It's free, so give it a shot if you don't have access to a paid VPN service!
2. Using Optus Game Path. You can access it here: https://www.optus.com.au/broadband-nbn/gaming-internet-plans/game-path

3. Using any VPN service of your choosing. Since the issue is how the Optus network reroutes the connection to our Australia server, this should potentially fix the high ping, no matter the service you use.
Again, we're sorry about this, and we hope these solutions can help you enjoy Friends vs Friends with us ❤️
Until next time!
Brainwash Gang & Raw Fury

items.text: Howdy, Friends!
It feels like both an eternity and no time has passed since we went live on Tuesday with the game! HUGE thanks to the community for turning up and battling your buds (and soon-to-be besties).

Our first major patch for Friends vs Friends is now live! We'd like to thank all of you for your support and feedback since launch, we hope you enjoy this latest update and the many more to come - we're just getting started.
Level-based Matchmaking

Matchmaking now properly takes level into account when searching for a match, which should result in much fairer games. Players who wish to disable this feature are able to. Please let us know if you run into any issues with this system!
Progression Revamp

We've heard your feedback loud and clear, the progression feels too slow. In this patch, we're making a number of changes both to the frequency of rewards, speed of leveling, and introducing a new level cap. These changes should make for a much more satisfying experience. Some of you may see some immediate level-ups as a result of this change, surprise! :)
Report system
You can now report players for suspicious activity on the match aftermath screen by pressing the "!" button in the right corner.
Fixed a bug where players could fall outside the map without dying by using the Ice Block card
Fixed a freeze when spamming the space bar while opening packs
Fixed: a bug where the camera could temporarily become offset when receiving explosion damage

We're working on a meaty update for tomorrow, right here on Steam, so keep your eyes peeled as we release our first of a weekly series we like to call the "Buddy's Bulletin"! We'll cover game updates, and community submissions, and start building out the lore of Friends vs Friends that you've been requesting!
Brainwash Gang & Raw Fury
